cards.english_title: Wounded Captain Honored After Saving a Plane
cards.korean_desc: 9월 30일 부기장이 기장을 공격했다 비행기는 30초 안에 약 14,000피트 떨어졌다 기장은 조종실 문을 열었다 10월 27일 UAE가 승무원에게 훈장을 줬다
cards.english_desc: On September 30, a co-pilot attacked Captain Smit Machchhar during flight FZ1073. The plane dropped nearly 14,000 feet in less than 30 seconds. Machchhar opened the cockpit door, allowing passengers to stop the attacker. On October 27, the UAE honored the crew with a high-level civil decoration.
cards.hook: A wounded captain helped save 170 passengers.
cards.takeaway_english: The award recognizes bravery, but the attack’s cause remains unanswered.

why_it_matters.english: Cockpit safety can affect everyone on a passenger flight.
The attack raised questions about emergency training and security.

parties.label: Smit Machchhar
parties.english: The injured captain helped passengers reach the cockpit and land safely.

parties.label: flydubai crew
parties.english: The crew helped overpower the co-pilot and protect passengers.

parties.label: UAE President
parties.english: He awarded the crew the First Class Order of Zayed II.

views.label: UAE officials
views.english: The crew showed courage, responsibility, and service during an extreme emergency.

views.label: Investigators
views.english: The attack’s motive remains unclear, and the co-pilot’s nationality was not officially confirmed by all authorities.

disagree.english: People may want a fuller public explanation of the attack and the investigation.
disagree.korean: 사람들은 더 자세한 설명을 원할 수 있다

cards.reader_question_korean: 이 공격 뒤 항공사는 무엇을 개선해야 할까요?

caption_lines: Flight FZ1073 was traveling from Dubai to Tel Aviv.
The award ceremony took place on October 27, 2026.
cards.reader_question: What should airlines improve after this attack?

cards.english_title: Trump Welcomes Bolsonaro After Brazil Election Loss
cards.korean_desc: 10월 25일 룰라가 플라비우스를 이겼다 결과는 보우소나루 가족의 복귀를 막았다 패배 뒤 플라비우스는 미국으로 떠났다 10월 28일 트럼프는 입국을 승인했다
cards.english_desc: On October 25, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil’s election. The result stopped a possible return of Jair Bolsonaro’s family to national power. After losing, Flávio Bolsonaro left Brazil for the United States. On October 28, Trump said he approved his entry, and visas were expected for his family.
cards.hook: Trump said Flávio Bolsonaro could enter America.
cards.takeaway_english: The visa decision gives Bolsonaro a U.S. refuge while Brazil’s political dispute continues.
cards.takeaway_korean: 비자 결정 뒤 브라질의 정치 논쟁은 계속된다

why_it_matters.english: The move links immigration decisions with international political relationships.
Brazil’s result may shape relations between Lula’s government and Trump.
why_it_matters.korean: 브라질 결과는 룰라와 트럼프의 관계에 영향을 준다

parties.label: Donald Trump
parties.english: He said he approved Flávio Bolsonaro coming to the United States.

parties.label: Flávio Bolsonaro
parties.english: He left Brazil after losing the presidential election.
parties.korean: 플라비우스는 대선 패배 뒤 브라질을 떠났다

parties.label: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
parties.english: He defeated Bolsonaro in Brazil’s presidential runoff.

views.label: Trump
views.english: Trump called the election very strange and criticized its result.

views.label: Brazilian election authorities
views.english: The election result gave Lula another term after the runoff vote.
views.korean: 선거 결과 룰라가 다시 임기를 얻었다

disagree.english: Critics may say Trump questioned the result without presenting evidence of wrongdoing.
disagree.korean: 비판자들은 트럼프가 근거 없이 결과를 의심했다고 말할 수 있다

cards.reader_question_korean: 선거 패배 뒤 정치 동맹은 특별 대우를 받아야 할까요?

cards.korean_title: 연준, 물가 속 금리 동결 전망
cards.english_title: Fed May Pause Despite Rising Inflation
cards.korean_desc: 10월 28일 연준은 금리를 유지할 전망이었다 이란 전쟁 뒤 기름값과 가스값이 올랐다 연준은 지난달 기준금리를 3.6%에서 3.9%로 올렸다 9월 소비자물가는 전년보다 3.7% 올랐다
cards.english_desc: On October 28, the Federal Reserve was expected to leave interest rates unchanged. Inflation accelerated after the Iran war pushed oil and gas prices higher. The Fed raised its key rate from about 3.6% to 3.9% last month. September consumer prices rose 3.7% from a year earlier, far above the target.
cards.hook: Inflation rose, but the Fed may pause.
cards.korean_hook: 물가는 올랐지만 연준은 멈출 수 있다
cards.takeaway_english: The pause may be temporary, with investors already expecting a possible December increase.

why_it_matters.english: Interest rates affect mortgages, car loans, credit cards, and business spending.
Inflation changes the cost of gas, groceries, clothing, and housing.

parties.label: Federal Reserve
parties.english: The central bank is expected to keep rates unchanged on October 28.

parties.label: Kevin Warsh
parties.english: The chair must explain why rates rose in September but may not rise now.

parties.label: American consumers
parties.english: Higher prices and borrowing costs are making daily life more expensive.
parties.korean: 미국 소비자들은 높은 비용을 겪고 있다

views.label: Federal Reserve officials
views.english: Holding rates could avoid adding pressure while inflation is partly driven by energy costs.
views.korean: 금리 유지는 에너지 부담을 피할 수 있다

views.label: Aditya Bhave, Bank of America
views.english: He says policymakers have been too relaxed about inflation above the target.
views.korean: 그는 연준이 높은 물가에 너무 느긋했다고 말한다

disagree.english: Others may say stronger rate increases are needed because inflation is far above the Fed’s target.
disagree.korean: 다른 사람들은 물가가 목표보다 높아 금리 인상이 필요하다고 말할 수 있다

cards.reader_question_korean: 연준은 물가와 대출자 중 누구를 먼저 보호해야 할까요?
cards.source_title: Federal Reserve likely to skip rate hike despite elevated inflation
caption_lines: The Fed’s meeting ends on October 28, 2026.
A separate PCE inflation measure was due October 29, 2026.
cards.reader_question: Should the Fed fight inflation or protect borrowers first?

cards.korean_title: 이스라엘 선거, 양쪽 모두 승리 주장
cards.english_title: Netanyahu and Rival Both Claim Israel’s Mandate
cards.korean_desc: 10월 27일 이스라엘은 총선을 열었다 이번 투표는 네타냐후 통치를 평가했다 출구조사는 두 진영을 약 51석으로 봤다 10월 28일 두 사람 모두 정부 구성을 주장했다
cards.english_desc: On October 27, Israel held its first election since the October 7, 2023 attack. The vote was widely seen as a judgment on Netanyahu’s divisive rule. Exit polls put both major blocs near 51 seats, below the 61-seat majority. On October 28, Netanyahu and Eisenkot both claimed they could form the next government.
cards.hook: Both blocs claimed victory without enough seats.
cards.korean_hook: 두 진영 모두 의석 부족에도 승리를 주장했다
cards.takeaway_english: Israel’s next government depends on coalition talks, not just the first vote count.
cards.takeaway_korean: 다음 정부는 연정 협상에 달려 있다

why_it_matters.english: The result may change Israel’s leadership and coalition policies.
why_it_matters.korean: 결과는 이스라엘 지도부와 정책을 바꿀 수 있다

why_it_matters.english: The election follows wars, political division, and the October 7 attack.

parties.label: Benjamin Netanyahu
parties.english: He called for a strong right-wing government.

parties.label: Gadi Eisenkot
parties.english: He said voters had rejected Netanyahu and promised to form a government quickly.

parties.label: Israeli Arab parties
parties.english: Their gains could influence coalition or minority-government talks.
parties.korean: 아랍 정당의 약진은 연정에 영향을 준다

views.label: Netanyahu’s camp
views.english: It argues that a Jewish and Zionist majority should lead the next government.
views.korean: 네타냐후 진영은 유대 시온주의 다수를 강조한다

views.label: Eisenkot’s camp
views.english: It says the vote showed public rejection of Netanyahu’s leadership.
views.korean: 아이젠코트 진영은 국민이 네타냐후를 거부했다고 말한다

disagree.english: Neither bloc reached 61 seats, so neither side can yet prove it has a governing majority.
disagree.korean: 어느 진영도 61석을 얻지 못해 승리를 확정할 수 없다

cards.reader_question_korean: 아랍 의원들은 다음 이스라엘 정부를 도와야 할까요?

caption_lines: A majority requires 61 of 120 Knesset seats.
Turnout was nearly 78%, the highest since 1999.
cards.reader_question: Should Arab lawmakers help form Israel’s next government?

cards.short_english: On October 27, Israel held its first election since the October 7, 2023 attack.

cards.english_title: Israel’s Opposition Leads, But Cannot Govern Alone
cards.korean_desc: 10월 27일 이스라엘 출구조사에서 야당이 앞섰다 야당은 120석 의회를 장악할 의석이 부족했다 리쿠드는 24석이나 25석으로 가장 컸다 아랍계 정당들은 17석이나 18석을 얻을 전망이었다
cards.english_desc: Israel’s first exit polls on October 27 gave the opposition a slight lead. The opposition still lacked enough seats to control the 120-seat Knesset. Likud remained the largest party, with a projected 24 or 25 seats. Arab-majority parties were projected to win 17 or 18 seats after high turnout.
cards.hook: The opposition led, but neither bloc had 61 seats.
cards.takeaway_english: The first numbers showed direction, but coalition arithmetic will decide power.
cards.takeaway_korean: 첫 숫자보다 연정 계산이 권력을 결정한다

why_it_matters.english: The Knesset result will decide who controls Israel’s next government.
Arab lawmakers may become important in coalition negotiations.
why_it_matters.korean: 아랍 의원들이 연정 협상에서 중요해질 수 있다

parties.label: Opposition bloc
parties.english: It held a slight exit-poll lead over Netanyahu’s bloc.

parties.label: Likud
parties.english: Netanyahu’s party remained the largest single party.

parties.label: Raam and Joint List
parties.english: The Arab-majority groups gained seats after high turnout.
parties.korean: 아랍계 정당들은 높은 투표율로 의석을 늘렸다

views.label: Gadi Eisenkot
views.english: He read the first polls as a rejection of Netanyahu’s government.

views.label: Election analysts
views.english: They warned that a small lead did not create a governing majority.
views.korean: 분석가들은 근소한 우세가 과반은 아니라고 경고했다

disagree.english: Later counting or coalition deals could change who actually forms the government.
disagree.korean: 개표와 연정 협상이 실제 정부를 바꿀 수 있다

cards.english_title: Trump Rolls Back Rules on Methane Leaks
cards.korean_desc: 10월 27일 트럼프는 미국 메탄 규제 완화를 발표했다 정부는 변화가 450억 달러를 절약한다고 말했다 변화는 누출 신고와 소규모 유정 규제를 약화한다 환경단체들은 메탄 오염과 건강 위험 증가를 경고했다
cards.english_desc: On October 27, Trump announced a broad rollback of U.S. oil and gas methane rules. His administration said the change would save consumers and producers $45 billion. The changes would weaken leak reporting, marginal-well rules, and associated-gas flaring limits. Environmental groups say weaker controls could increase methane pollution and health risks.
cards.hook: Trump loosened rules targeting oil and gas methane.
cards.korean_hook: 트럼프가 석유와 가스 메탄 규제를 풀었다
cards.takeaway_english: The rollback could lower industry burdens while increasing debate over climate and health risks.
cards.takeaway_korean: 완화는 비용을 낮추지만 기후 논쟁을 키울 수 있다

why_it_matters.english: Methane traps much more heat than carbon dioxide over a shorter period.
why_it_matters.korean: 메탄은 짧은 기간 더 많은 열을 가둔다

why_it_matters.english: Rules affect energy producers and communities near oil and gas operations.
why_it_matters.korean: 규제는 생산자와 주변 지역에 영향을 준다

parties.label: Donald Trump
parties.english: He announced a broad rollback of methane rules on October 27.

parties.label: Environmental Protection Agency
parties.english: The EPA says the change could save consumers and producers $45 billion.

parties.label: Environmental groups
parties.english: They warn weaker rules could mean more leaks, pollution, and health risks.

views.label: Trump administration
views.english: Officials say weaker rules will reduce costs and unlock more Texas natural gas.
views.korean: 정부는 규제 완화가 비용을 줄인다고 말한다

views.label: Fieldnotes and environmental advocates
views.english: They say the rollback would leave dangerous methane leaks less controlled.
views.korean: 환경 advocates는 메탄 누출 통제가 약해진다고 말한다

disagree.english: Supporters may argue that industry costs and energy prices matter more than stricter federal oversight.
disagree.korean: 지지자들은 산업 비용과 에너지가 더 중요하다고 말할 수 있다

cards.reader_question_korean: 저렴한 에너지가 강한 메탄 규제보다 먼저일까요?
